object.attr: stakeholder: new_object, update_object, copy_object and bulk_set_attribute return a partial result when a write fails partway, leaving a half-made change for the agent to clean up, unlike the GUI. Decided on 2026-11-10.
object.description: If a file can't be written or deleted during an MCP tool call that edits a document, Mellon shall return each file the call already wrote or deleted to its state before the call.
